featured_reviews.name: Jayesh Mewada
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Sanjhi for the first time and honestly, I was surprised by the variety they have! It's a pure veg/Jain restaurant which is hard to find for Chinese food lovers. The place has a proper Chinatown vibe with red lanterns and decor . We were greeted with that complimentary crispy noodles & schezwan chutney while waiting – nice touch .

We ordered Manchow soup (absolute must-try) and Triple Schezwan Rice – both were delicious and the quantity is good . The service was quick. Definitely coming back next time with friends to try their sizzlers and sizzling brownie which everyone keeps recommending .

Great atmosphere, pocket-friendly, and perfect for family or friends . Highly recommend for anyone looking for quality veg Chinese in Dahisar!

Tip: Go on a weekday if possible – weekends get quite crowded !

featured_reviews.name: Jiten Davda
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have been dining here since Day 1 of its opening since i stay around.

However over the years the quality of the food has degraded. Expanding their menu and introducing variety of other cuisine had impacted the taste of the Chinese dishes.

Had ordered fried rice and it felt like sticky rice and tasteless.
The hong kong rice had too much of spices which ruined the actual taste.

They are overwhelmed by the demands and unable to cater to everyone on time. Hence no more focus on customer service.

What disappointed me the most is if you ask for regular drinking water. They have only chilled water which is purified, if you want a regular room temperature water, you have to pay for a bottled water.

When i highlighted this issue to the manager he casually said “sab jagah aisa hi hota hai”

Hence, do no fall for the hype anymore.

THEY ACCEPT ONLY CASH PAYMENT !!

featured_reviews.name: Tanvi
featured_reviews.review_text:
A Vegetarian Chinese restaurant is in itself such a unique concept. To execute it well, is another challenge. Sanjhi Nails it. It's vegetarian, It offers lots of authentic Chinese cuisine... And it's Budget-friendly! 🤌🏼

The vibe gives you that "Chinese Restaurant" wale feels. Interior of the restaurant is well thought. Lighting is bit dim, making it perfect for a date as well 😉 There's AC sitting as well. Staff is very nice - Menu was explained properly. And the Waiter made sure to cover the serving bowl so that food stays warm 🥹

They even serve Pav Bhaji, Sandwich, etc. Menu is really exhaustive. We ordered Chef's Special Mexican Paneer Starter & Koi Tiow Phad Phak Flat Noodles.

THE STARTER was really tasty, couldn't figure how it was "Mexican" tho. Maybe bcoz it had Basil, Capsicum?! Taste wise it was good. Paneer was soft as expected.

FLAT NOODLES were chewy and great in taste. They use exotic veggies like Broccoli, Red cabbage, Basil, Zucchini etc.

Can't wait to visit again!

I recently ordered from Babu's Kitchen (which is under new management), all the way to Gorai through swiggy and was blown away by their incredible selection of wok-tossed momos. These are not commonly found.
The wok tossed Chilli Garlic Momos were an absolute flavor bomb, perfectly balanced with just the right kick of heat and garlic.
The Wok tossed Sweet & Spicy Momos offered a delightful contrast, with their tangy sweetness complementing the spicy undertone beautifully.
And the wok tossed Momo Chilly was a true standout, with its smoky, bold flavors and irresistible crunch. Each dish was fresh, flavorful, and packed with authentic taste. If you're a momo lover, this place is an absolute must-try!

featured_reviews.review_text: I recently dined at Babu's Kitchen and it left me thoroughly impressed. The food quality was exceptional, with each dish bursting with authentic flavors and expertly prepared ingredients. Not only was the taste outstanding, but the portion sizes were generous, ensuring a satisfying meal. What pleasantly surprised me the most was the reasonable prices they offered. The affordability did not compromise the taste or quantity, making it a perfect choice for both a quick bite or a full-blown feast. If you're searching for a Chinese restaurant that excels in food quality, quantity, and reasonable prices, look no further!

featured_reviews.name: isha hule
featured_reviews.review_text: Babu's Kitchen is a delightful Chinese restaurant that exceeded my expectations in every way. The food quality here is impeccable, leaving my taste buds dancing with joy. The flavors are authentic and the ingredients are fresh, making each dish a true delight. What surprised me the most were the reasonable prices, allowing me to indulge in a scrumptious feast without breaking the bank. Moreover, the owner's hospitality truly made me feel like a valued guest. Their warmth and attentiveness added an extra layer of enjoyment to my dining experience. I highly recommend trying the Garlic Chicken for its tantalizing aroma, the Paneer Crispy for its perfect crispiness, the Chicken Lollipop for its juicy tenderness, and the Chicken Combination Rice for a fulfilling meal. Babu's Kitchen is a gem worth exploring!

featured_reviews.name: Momo Explorer
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Had a great experience at Sizzling Spices in Dahisar West! The food was absolutely delicious — especially the Kurkure Momos, Korean Wings, and Osaka Ramen. The chicken was juicy and full of flavour. I also loved that they don’t use MSG, ajinomoto, or food colour, so the food felt clean and light. Portions are generous, staff is friendly, and service was smooth. Definitely a hidden gem for Asian food lovers. Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: vishal sawant
featured_reviews.review_text:
I visited Sizzling Spices in Dahisar with my friends this weekend, and it turned out to be a delightful experience for Asian food lovers. The place is small but cozy, with quick and humble service that makes you feel welcome.

We began with the Chicken Eight Treasure Soup, which was packed with a variety of vegetables along with chicken – light, healthy, and a good start. Next came the Korean-style Crispy Chicken, essentially chicken katsu paired with honey chilli sauce. While the sauce was average, the katsu itself was perfectly crispy and enjoyable.

The highlight of the evening was undoubtedly the Chicken Thai Green Curry Pot Rice. Aromatic, rich in flavor, and served in a portion easily sufficient for three, it stood out as the star dish.

Overall, Sizzling Spices is a nice spot if you’re in the mood for hearty and flavorful Asian cuisine. Definitely worth a visit.

featured_reviews.name: Danny Fernandes
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently placed an order from Sizzling Spices, and the highlight of my meal was undeniably the Chicken Thai Pot Rice. This dish is a true testament to the restaurant's dedication to delivering authentic Thai flavors in a sizzling and satisfying way.
The presentation of the Chicken Thai Pot Rice was visually appealing, served in a sizzling hot pot. The aroma alone was enough to make my mouth water. The dish featured tender pieces of chicken, perfectly cooked and seasoned to perfection, accompanied by a generous serving of rice.
The Thai spices were expertly balanced, offering a delightful combination of sweet, sour, and spicy notes. Fresh herbs and vegetables added a refreshing crunch to each bite, while the fragrant lemongrass and coconut milk infused the dish with an authentic Thai essence.The portion size was generous, making it ideal for sharing or savoring as a satisfying meal. The sizzling pot kept the dish warm throughout the meal, ensuring that every bite was as enjoyable as the first.

featured_reviews.name: Akshay Powale
featured_reviews.review_text:
Sizzling Spices is a really good Chinese food restaurant.

The food is almost always delicious, there might be some hit or miss dishes but overall good food.
If you dine in, the service is really good  and the food plating and it's presentation is great!
The delivery service is good as well.
The restaurant and it's ambience itself is decent.
And the food is reasonably priced which is a big big plus.

My only real inconvenience was when some customers ordered double servings of brownie ice cream with sizzling chocolate.. Even tho it smelt and looked amazing, double serving basically filled the restaurant with smoke.

So all in all its always a good experience having food from or at Sizzling spice. Try it out!
